# RevKit.online — Full Software & Reverse Engineering Index (2026)

> Full index of 958 tools with verified licenses, platforms, and repositories (https://revkit.online).

## Category: Disassemblers & Decompilers

### [Ghidra](https://revkit.online/tools/ghidra/)
- Description: Decompiles and analyzes binary executables into C/C++ source code with NSA toolchain.
- Category: Disassemblers & Decompilers
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Free
- Replaces: IDA Pro
- GitHub: https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
- Official: https://ghidra-sre.org
